repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The candidate re-reads the sensor inside the `if` condition instead of using the stored snapshot `h2`. The IR requires comparing the initial value `h1` with the value read after the delay (`h2`). F2 shows the IR emitted `switch.on` at 1200000ms, but the candidate emitted nothing because its condition evaluated to false (comparing a fresh read against `h2` instead of `h1`).
diagnosis.change_summary: Replaced the direct sensor read in the `if` condition with the stored variable `h1` to match the IR's logic of comparing two snapshots separated by a delay.
